messages.author: 43f5744093db5550
messages.subject: profvis example for shiny app
parts:
Hi, I saw Garrett did a demo to use profvis within a shiny app. it is very impressive. But when I tried it in several parts of my server.R file, none of them worked. Can someone post a few examples to use profvis in shiny app?
thanks
wei

messages.author: dc3c7e88d9ea3297
messages.subject: Re: profvis example for shiny app
parts: I think you need to wrap the entire app in profvis. Probably best to use it on self contained pieces of code anyways.

On Friday, February 5, 2016 at 11:38:08 AM UTC-6, Wei Zou wrote:

thanks
wei

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: profvis example for shiny app
parts: Call profvis({ shiny::runApp() }) or something like that to use profvis with Shiny.

# Run dashboard app on port 8888

library(profvis)
profvis({
  shiny::runApp(
    appDir = dirname(sys.frame(1)$ofile),
    port = 8888,
    launch.browser = FALSE,
